factual_claims.source_evidence: Market funding increased to ISK 101.7 bn. at the end of Q2 2026, following the issuance of EUR 150 million senior unsecured bonds and SEK 300 million AT1 capital instruments during H1 2026... Compared with the Bank’s inaugural EUR senior preferred issuance in May 2025, pricing improved by 85 basis points.

factual_claims.claim: The bank maintained a strong capital and liquidity position, with a capital adequacy ratio of 23.0% and a common equity tier one ratio of 17.7%, both remaining well above regulatory requirements.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: CAR of 23.0% at 30 June 2026... CET1... 17.7%. Text states 'CAR of 23.0%... well above regulatory requirements.'

factual_claims.claim: The liquidity coverage ratio stood at 276% and the net stable funding ratio at 137%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: The liquidity coverage ratio (LCR) remains strong at 276%, well above the 100% regulatory requirement. NSFR stood at 137%.

factual_claims.claim: Strategic and operational developments during the period included ongoing preparations for the divestment of Straumur greiðslumiðlun hf. and the announcement that CEO Ármann Þorvaldsson will step down by year-end 2026 after nearly ten years with the group.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Section headers: 'Sale of Straumur greiðslumiðlun hf. in progress' and 'CEO Ármann Þorvaldsson to step down by year-end 2026' with supporting text.
